mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year Consumer Price Index increase above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and nonfarm payrolls indicates a deteriorating labor market where job creation is insufficient to absorb new entrants, signaling potential economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS falls > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,400,000 units annually, it signals robust residential construction activity that typically precedes economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in the high housing demand regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-3.5% unemployment rate signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and subsequent Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and year-over-year CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2022 monetary tightening regime, a decline in the federal funds rate signals the Federal Reserve is ending the hiking cycle and beginning easing, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp within the post-2022 regime, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.
